ios.desc:
Bitcoin only. No altcoins, no account, no custody.

Bitcoin Tracker does one asset properly: the live BTC price, alerts that reach you, and a portfolio that shows your real cost basis and profit. Your portfolio stays on your device.

Most crypto apps bury Bitcoin under a thousand tickers and ask you to sign up before you see a number. This one opens straight to the price.

FREE — NO ACCOUNT, NO SIGN-UP
• Live Bitcoin price with clean, interactive charts
• Market Signals: trend, momentum, drawdown and sentiment, read at a glance
• Follow BTC in several fiat currencies at once
• Price alerts above or below your target, with full trigger history
• A daily market brief at a time you choose — price, 24h change and Fear & Greed
• Portfolio tracking: add buys by hand, watch any address, or a whole hardware wallet from its xpub, ypub or zpub
• Real cost basis (FIFO, LIFO, HIFO or average), fees, labels and notes
• Accumulation goals, with a nudge as you pass each milestone
• Network stats: block height, mempool, supply, and what a transaction will cost
• The halving countdown, and drawdown from the all-time high
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets for price, stack goal, halving and Moscow Time

HODLER PRO

Alerts the moment it happens
Price targets, big 24h moves, the Mayer Multiple, network fees and Hash Ribbons — checked every minute and pushed even when the app is closed. Plus a Sunday recap of the week.

Know what Bitcoin is worth
Power-law fair value, Mayer Multiple and Pi Cycle Top on Bitcoin's full history, each with a plain-English reading.

Watch the network's health
Hash Ribbons, hashprice, and Lightning Network capacity and node counts.

Are you actually beating DCA?
Benchmark your real buys against a cash-flow matched dollar-cost-average baseline, and simulate any DCA plan against more than a decade of history.

Ready for tax time
Realized gains by tax year with your cost basis method, exported as CSV or PDF. Break-even price and "what if BTC hits…" scenarios.

Read the market without reading charts
RSI, MACD and 20W/50W/200W moving averages, cycle and halving analytics, monthly return heatmaps, correlation with the S&P 500, Nasdaq and gold, and corporate treasury tracking.

Also in Pro
• Unlimited alerts
• One-second live prices streamed from the order book
• CSV import
• Midnight, Gold and Mono app icons

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
There is no account to create and nothing to sign in to. Your portfolio, wallets and extended public keys stay on your device.

quotes.text:
I wanted to share a project I've been working on. Like many of you, I was frustrated with existing portfolio apps. They prioritize multi-asset ticker lists, bombard you with altcoin clutter, and often harvest your portfolio data.

I couldn't find a clean, dedicated app that just focused on Bitcoin, so I decided to build my own.

My core architectural principle from day one was your data is yours:

100% Local Storage: Your portfolio balances, addresses, and transaction history are stored entirely on your device. Zero user data is sent to external servers.
No Custody, No Execution: It's strictly an analytics and tracking tool. You remain in full control.
Open Data Sourcing: It only uses open APIs for price and network state. Where historical data is missing from third-party APIs, the app locally caches and accumulates data to generate your metrics.
Because the app doesn't have to worry about 10,000 different tokens, it focuses entirely on the tools and intelligence long-term Bitcoin holders actually care about:

Flexible Portfolio Tracking: You can add transactions manually, upload a CSV, or import directly from public wallet addresses (with the ability to select specific transactions).
Accurate P&L: Edit metadata like cost basis, fees, and notes to get an exact picture of your portfolio performance and drawdowns.
Native Network Stats: Track block height, mempool pressure, transaction fees, circulating supply, and halving countdowns directly in the app.
